C1_waypoint_elevation_chain.note: waypoint elevations were derived from the same HiRISE terrain model: proves the coordinate chain only

C2a_rover_in_hirise.method: brightest new object (post minus pre, high-pass normalised) within 15 m of the parked waypoint; blob centroid

C2b_traverse_vs_dark_band.method: mean darkness of a 2 m band centred on the traverse vs 3-6 m to each side, both images high-pass normalised; trial offsets +-15 m
C2b_traverse_vs_dark_band.reading: the pre-landing basemap shows a weaker dark band at nearly the same offset: the rover tends to drive on darker, smoother ground, so this signal is not purely tracks
